active: R1 (adopted 2026-10-15; evidence: 10-02, 10-07, 10-15; look-back: right 3 of 5 — fades 10-02, 10-07, 10-15; continuations 10-06 (+0.43%), 10-14 (-0.40% borderline); since adopted: 2-1 — 10-19 W (gap +3.98, close 0.75 below open); 10-22 L (gap -6.72/-0.87% on META/TSLA/LRCX AI-capex earnings, NQ -1.8% vs ES -1.1% pre-mkt, extended -0.31% open→close; see W16); 10-23 W (gap -4.06/-0.53% at the open though the 7:57 brief saw only -0.2% — do the 9:25 recheck; close +0.07 above open, barely)) — When SPY is indicated to open >=0.4% away from the prior close at 9:25 ET (either direction), then lean against the gap open->close (one step toward the fade) and cap prob at 55%; the first hour may still follow the gap.
